scope: representation-aware static audit of released or generated final assets

cohort_policy.selection: freeze before Table 7 scoring and never filter on build or geometry outcome
cohort_policy.failed_or_missing_outputs: retain in requested denominator and report separately; do not fabricate mesh scores
cohort_policy.paper_only_values: keep separate from locally measured values

geometry.loader: trimesh scene load with process=false; score every readable triangle geometry
geometry.watertight: trimesh is_watertight for each readable geometry
geometry.manifold: edge-manifold proxy: every undirected edge has at most two incident faces; vertex-manifold is not claimed
geometry.open_edges: number of undirected edges with exactly one incident face
geometry.degenerate_faces: face has a repeated vertex index or area <= 1e-12 in native squared units
geometry.self_intersection: not_evaluable unless an exact triangle-triangle backend is recorded and adjacent faces are excluded
geometry.load_failure: record error and exclude only from geometry-evaluable denominator; never count as a clean mesh
aggregation: per-asset mean fraction across readable geometries

size_bytes.source: method-attributable executable source bytes; shared factory source is reported separately from per-asset source
size_bytes.mesh: all referenced or packaged mesh payload bytes, deduplicated by canonical path within each asset
size_bytes.aggregation: total and arithmetic mean over the explicitly named denominator

portable_package.procedure: copy the complete asset package to a fresh temporary directory inside the authorized workspace, then parse the copied primary artifact and resolve every declared dependency
pass: all declared dependencies exist in the copied package
all dependency references are relative and remain inside the copied package
no required dependency resolves through an external symlink
portable_package.fail: an available final package violates any pass condition
portable_package.not_evaluable: no final package was released or generated

deterministic_build.pass: two fresh builds from the same frozen source, configuration, environment and seed produce equal canonical manifests and content hashes
deterministic_build.fail: both builds complete but canonical manifests or content hashes differ
deterministic_build.not_evaluable: a second fresh build is not actually executed or the build inputs/environment are not frozen
deterministic_build.prohibited_shortcut: re-hashing one existing artifact is not a deterministic-build experiment

semantic_complete.strict_result: not_evaluable without an output-independent required-part and role specification
field_proxy: all delivered mesh-bearing parts have non-empty non-placeholder names
the delivered hierarchy parses as one rooted connected acyclic structure
native semantic roles, when required by the method contract, are present
semantic_complete.reporting: report the field proxy separately and never label it semantic correctness

pass: all joint parent and child references resolve
all movable one-axis joints declare a finite nonzero axis
revolute and prismatic joints declare finite ordered lower and upper limits
all joints declare a finite origin transform
kinematic_complete.continuous_joint_rule: axis and finite origin are required; position limits are not
kinematic_complete.not_evaluable: the native representation does not expose joints or no final package exists

pass: every visual-bearing physical link has native collision geometry
every physical link has positive finite mass
every physical link has finite positive-definite native inertia
every movable joint has native damping and friction values
native contact material or friction metadata is present
physical_complete.runtime_defaults: simulator-supplied mass, inertia, damping, friction or collision are failures, not native metadata

self_checks: requested denominator equals pass plus fail plus unavailable where applicable
all rates have explicit numerators and denominators
all referenced evidence files exist inside the authorized workspace
protocol and manifest SHA-256 values are recorded
